statement:
I'll look up the setpoint record for reactor R-2 first.
**I cannot apply this setting—the recorded value of 950 psi is unsafe and incorrect for this case.** Reactor R-2 is built to withstand only 600 psi, so a relief valve opening at 950 psi would allow pressure to exceed the vessel's design limit, risking a catastrophic burst before the valve opens.

The setpoint record must be corrected before proceeding. The relief valve should open at a pressure safely below 600 psi—typically around 85–90% of the maximum design pressure, which would be approximately 510–540 psi. Please verify the correct setpoint with engineering and correct the record.
